summary: Assay worksheet for MV-2015-240, the AT15 GPCR lead oral and IV rat exposure study for Aldrevessa Therapeutics: 40 sulfonyl piperazine analogues dosed IV and PO, with LC-MS/MS bioanalysis and matrix acceptance. Systemic clearance was acceptable across the set, but oral exposure was limited for most analogues, which led Aldrevessa to revisit the dosing vehicle before the next exposure gate.
